curatorReview.title: Pool Nation FX
curatorReview.reason: Physical PS4 release status is genuinely uncertain. Search results only confirmed a physical release for the separate, earlier "Pool Nation" (#922) identity; no confirmation (positive or negative) was found specifically for "Pool Nation FX". Per instructions, search silence is not proof of absence -- left INCLUDED, flagged for a future targeted pass rather than excluded on absence of evidence.
curatorReview.resolutionNote: RESOLVED: CONFIRMED_EXCLUDE (digital-only, confirmed via official PS Store listing).

curatorReview.reason: Previously assumed (in an earlier cover-art pass, PR #22) to be the same game based on near-identical titles and treated as such for COVER REUSE ONLY -- this pass's deeper research complicates that assumption: both are developed by the same studio (Z-Software GmbH) but published under what appear to be two DIFFERENT publisher deals ("3D MiniGolf" by Merge Games vs. "3D Mini Golf" by familyplay), a known pattern for this developer's many similarly-titled budget minigolf releases across different publishers/regions. This could mean either genuinely the same product under two storefront listings, or two distinct budget SKUs. NOT confidently classified as a duplicate this pass -- both identities remain INCLUDED and unmerged. The prior cover-reuse decision is flagged here for Josh's awareness since its premise ("clearly the same game") is now less certain than when it was made; not reversed in this pass since that is a cover-scope change, not a census change.
curatorReview.resolutionNote: RESOLVED: CONFIRMED_DUPLICATE (#9 excluded, canonical #10) -- same underlying game confirmed via matching official PS Store content descriptions across both publisher listings.
